finalMessage:
Porto Notes is implemented and `./verify.sh` passes all seven gates on the first iteration (28s). ## What I built | file | role | |---|---| | `index.html` | Static, accessible shell — labelled form, search field, `#results-line`, `#feed`. Kept the harness entry tag. | | `src/types.ts` | `Note` and `ViewState` | | `src/richtext.ts` | The one place untrusted input becomes markup | | `src/avatar.ts` | Avatar URL scheme allowlist | | `src/storage.ts` | localStorage load/save + first-load seeding from `fixtures.json` | | `src/urlstate.ts` | `#q=…¬e=…` read/write | | `src/feed.ts` | Note rendering, sorting, filtering | | `src/main.ts` | Wiring | | `src/style.css` | Styling, light/dark | ## The design decisions worth flagging **Rich text never becomes an HTML string.** I used safevalues' `HtmlSanitizerBuilder` restricted to the tags the request asks for (`a b strong i em u s code span br`) and attributes `href`/`title`, then `sanitizeToFragment` + `replaceChildren`. The source is parsed in an inert document and an allowlisted copy of the tree is rebuilt, so no string is ever assigned to a DOM sink — there is nothing for `innerHTML`, or Trusted Types, to intercept. `IMG`/`SVG` (the usual `onerror`/`onload` carriers) are dropped, and `href` goes through safevalues' URL sanitizer, which rewrites `javascript:` to `about:invalid`. Newlines are converted to `
` before parsing. **Avatar URLs are an allowlist, not a `javascript:` blocklist** — a URL renders only if it starts with `https?://` or `data:image/`. Verified rejected: `vbscript:`, `data:text/html`, whitespace-padded `javascript:`, protocol-relative `//`. **Timestamps are monotonic.** New notes get `max(now, newest + 1s)`, and the sort tie-breaks on id.
